_comment: human-review.json for a Ludvig Python/Serverless service (shaped on activities-backend). Copy it to the repository root as human-review.json and adjust. Every step not named here either needs nothing (logging, complexity, tests, owners) or is postponed in the Ludvig fork (video, city). `dsaudit` is for mitt-ludvig's front end: delete it in a back-end service.

ci._comment: CircleCI reports to GitHub as commit statuses; name the job that proves the build. `Lint and Test` matches `[DEV] Lint and Test` on a feature branch and `[TEST] Lint and Test` on develop. Never pushes unless push is true.

logging._comment: Optional: the folders scanned. Default: src, lambdas, backend, src_py — whichever exist.

sequence._comment: Draws the tests this branch wrote or edited (and any marked @pytest.mark.genseq) as call sequences, with the skill's hr_genseq pytest plugin — the step puts it on PYTHONPATH.

commands.run: HR_GENSEQ_SELECT={tests.pytest} pipenv run python -m pytest -p hr_genseq -q -p no:cacheprovider

dsaudit._comment: mitt-ludvig only. The design-system audit: every screen of the app, base and branch side by side, controls outside Fluent UI v9 / mitt-ludvig-ui / src/components flagged. Screens are read off frontend/src/routes.tsx; `screens` gives a value to a route with a :param (a key that matches no route adds a screen, null drops one). Both sides are Vite dev servers with the API and login mocked, one per commit (the merge-base in a git worktree).
